channel_observation.title: He Tested 4,700 Paywalls. These Won.
channel_observation.improvement_note: For this video, front-load a 10-to-12-second cold open around the counterintuitive ‘same offer, opposite outcome’ example, using two paywall screens side by side and one clean label for the audience-size constraint. Break the long single-camera stretch from roughly 1:00 to 4:00 with a few purposeful UI checkpoints tied to each experiment stage. This would make the title's promise concrete earlier without adding decorative motion.
channel_observation.boundary: This is an editorial observation from sampled public frames, not access to retention data or a claim that the change would improve a measured metric.
